scope: Real email node parsing, fallback rendering and stored workflow snapshots
behavior: The real parser action accepts its documented null tokens result, succeeds durably, propagates confidence and metadata, and replays through the node without adding a second invocation.
The email node sanitizes emitted HTML on successful parsing and unavailable/throwing parser fallback, preserving useful text and safe links.
Real render node persists readable text blocks when HTML conversion returns unavailable or throws.
Removed three equivalent retired tests: parsedEmail confidence storage, HTML unsafe-content removal and renderCommentBlocks fallback. Twenty-six retired cases remain.

dependencies.runtime: Declared existing locked DOMPurify 3.4.13 and jsdom 25.0.1 as direct shared dependencies; lazy server-only sanitizer, no jsdom scripts or resource fetching enabled.

limits: Local migrated PostgreSQL fixtures with substituted connection/auth boundaries; no updated native CI candidate proof.
HTML sanitization applies to the node output, not every parser caller or raw diagnostic field. Raw input/low-confidence metadata remains diagnostic data requiring safe rendering.
HTML conversion failures and parser fallback conditions inject action handlers; successful parser case uses the real action and parser.
Production entry checks exercise workflow bundling, not a fresh production worker image build.
The remaining retired email cases and broad plan requirements remain open.
